modalities.evidence: conducting phantom CT studies with an anthropomorphic thoracic phantom

output.population: An anthropomorphic thoracic phantom containing a vasculature insert on which synthetic nodules were inserted or attached; ten repeat scans per protocol and nodule layout.
output.summary: Repeat CT scans of an anthropomorphic thoracic phantom with synthetic nodules of known size and location, acquired across imaging protocols and nodule layouts to assess lung nodule size estimation methods.
